Stack: Jetpack Compose, Kotlin Flow.
project_android_boxoffice_full_desc:
Octopusfx Box Office is an Android app built for NextGet Consulting to track parcels for a transport company. It provides role-based flows for drivers, warehouse agents, and administrators, each with their own screens and permissions.

Key features include QR/barcode scanning for parcel tracking, geolocation and guided navigation for deliveries, and a secure handover process with identity verification and electronic signature. The interface is multilingual to support field teams. Built with Jetpack Compose and Kotlin Flow.

project_multiplatform_chirp_desc: Cross-platform messaging app (Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux) connected to a Kotlin Spring Boot backend. Stack: Compose Multiplatform, WebSockets, Firebase, RabbitMQ — real-time messaging, push notifications, photo upload, pagination, offline mode, sign-up with email verification and deep links.
project_multiplatform_chirp_full_desc:
Chirp is a cross-platform messaging app built during a Full-Stack Kotlin training program (PL Coding × JetBrains). The Compose Multiplatform client runs on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux from a single codebase, connected to a Kotlin Spring Boot backend that handles real-time messaging over WebSockets, push notifications via Firebase, photo uploads, and conversation pagination.

The app includes offline support, sign-up with email verification and deep links, and server-side security measures such as password hashing and rate limiting. Backend deployment is automated through a CI/CD pipeline.
project_multiplatform_socialnetwork_desc: iOS & Android app from a single codebase with Kotlin Multiplatform and Supabase: sign-up, sessions, profile completion (photo, bio), role management, access restricted to completed profiles. Stack: KMP, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Row Level Security.
project_multiplatform_socialnetwork_full:
This cross-platform social network, built with Kotlin Multiplatform for iOS and Android from a single codebase, relies on Supabase for authentication, session management, and data storage.

The user journey includes sign-up, profile completion (photo, bio), and app access restricted to completed profiles. Data is hosted in a PostgreSQL database protected by Row Level Security (RLS) rules, ensuring each user only accesses their own data and whatever their role permits.
